description: This file integrates Facebook SDK into a PHP web application, handling user authentication via Facebook and rendering different content based on login status. It includes initialization of the SDK, user login state checking, and setting up Facebook JavaScript SDK asynchronously.

classes.name: Facebook
classes.description: A class representing Facebook SDK interactions, including methods for initializing SDK, user authentication, and API calls.

methods.name: Facebook::__construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Facebook SDK with provided app ID and secret.

methods.name: Facebook::getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user ID, if any.

methods.name: Facebook::api
methods.description: Performs an API call to Facebook Graph API (e.g., '/me' for user profile).

methods.name: Facebook::getAppID
methods.description: Returns the Application ID configured in the Facebook SDK object.
